input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='ebike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' THEN minutes ELSE 0 END) AS classic_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='ebike' THEN minutes ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' THEN over45 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_over45_minutes FROM trips

SELECT week_start, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(minutes), 1) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(COUNT(*)*UNLOCK + SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' THEN minutes ELSE 0 END)*CLASSIC_RATE + SUM(CASE WHEN bike='ebike' THEN minutes ELSE 0 END)*EBIKE_RATE, 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 8
